The rule codes only what needs no judgment: a reply with no letter or digit is 'uncoded'; a reply that is exactly one of a closed list of plain non-answers (no, none, nothing, n/a, idk, no idea, not sure, I don't know, nothing odd / in particular / really), with sentence punctuation only, is 'non_answer'; every other reply is 'needs_coder'. 'uncoded' and 'non_answer' are not suspicious by definition (they link nothing to prosociality); no rule ever codes 'suspicious'.
